description.value:
You belonged to a faction of traders, caravan masters, and shopkeepers rather than one of crafters — buying and selling other people's work rather than making your own. Maybe you ran cargo between systems for a galaxy-spanning consortium, or bought from traveling traders to sell out of your own storefront.

The trading life took you farther and put you in more precarious situations than most artisans ever see, and your faction's name still carries weight wherever its trade routes reach.

system.equipment: A letter of introduction from your faction, a set of traveler's clothes, and a belt pouch containing 150 credits.
